newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Four foreigners drown as boat sinks in Manila Bay.
newsitem.headline: Four foreigners drown as boat sinks in Manila Bay.

text.p: At least four people, including one child, drowned after a pleasure boat sank in Manila Bay on Friday, a doctor attending the victims said.
Milo Villena, a doctor at the nearby Ospital ng Maynila, said three women and a child had died.
"Out of the four adults, three are already dead. As for (children)...one is pronounced dead," he told a radio station.
Two other children are under observation.
A tour guide said all the victims were foreigners.
Radio reports said the sightseeing boat, with 43 Hong Kong Chinese and two Japanese on board, sank after being hit by strong winds.
